name: Knotless Box Braids
description: Our most requested style. No knot at the root, so there is no tension and no itching. Allow 6-7 hours.

name: Knotless Box Braids
description: The everyday knotless. Lighter on the scalp than classic box braids and lasts 6-8 weeks. Allow 4-5 hours.

name: Knotless Box Braids
description: A quicker, bolder look. Great first appointment if you have never had braids. Allow 3 hours.

name: Classic Box Braids
description: The traditional box braid with a sealed root. Firmer finish, holds its shape longer. Allow 5 hours.

name: Bohemian Box Braids
description: Knotless braids left loose and curled from the mid-length down. Soft, undone finish. Allow 6 hours.

name: Triangle Part Box Braids
description: Triangular parting instead of square, for a sharper pattern across the scalp. Allow 5-6 hours.

name: Goddess Box Braids
description: Knotless braids blended into a second color, with loose wavy pieces through the length. Allow 6-7 hours.

name: Straight-Back Cornrows
description: Clean straight-back rows on your own hair. No extensions. A good protective base under a wig. Allow 1.5 hours.

name: Straight-Back Cornrows
description: Finer straight-back rows for a more detailed finish. No extensions. Allow 2 hours.

name: Feed-In Cornrows
description: Hair fed in gradually so the rows thicken naturally from the hairline. Allow 3 hours.

name: Fulani Braids
description: Centre-parted cornrows with side braids and beadwork, finished with box braids at the back. Allow 4-5 hours.

name: Lemonade Braids
description: All rows swept to one side. Bold, sculptural, and comfortable to sleep in. Allow 3-4 hours.

name: Stitch Braids
description: Precise stitched parting with visible clean lines. The most detailed cornrow work we do. Allow 4 hours.

name: Cornrow Ponytail
description: Cornrows gathered into a single braided ponytail. Smart enough for work, sturdy enough for the gym. Allow 2.5 hours.

name: Freestyle Cornrow Design
description: Curved, swirled or geometric parting designed with you at the chair. Price varies with complexity. Allow 4-5 hours.

name: Senegalese Twists
description: Smooth rope twists with a silky finish. Lightweight and long-lasting. Allow 5 hours.

name: Marley Twists
description: Chunkier twists using coarse Marley hair for a natural, matte look. Allow 4-5 hours.

name: Passion Twists
description: Springy twists with a wet-look curl pattern. Popular through summer. Allow 4 hours.

name: Havana Twists
description: Large, light twists that install quickly and sit softly. Allow 3-4 hours.

name: Kinky Twists
description: Fine twists with a coily texture that blends closely with natural hair. Allow 5-6 hours.

name: Flat Twists
description: Two-strand twists flat to the scalp on your own hair. No extensions. Often worn as a base or overnight set. Allow 1.5 hours.

name: Twist Out Set
description: Twisted, dried and unravelled for a full defined curl. Includes wash and conditioning. Allow 2 hours.

name: Kids Cornrows
description: Straight-back rows on natural hair. Gentle tension, and we work at their pace. Allow 1 hour.

name: Kids Box Braids
description: Knotless box braids sized for children, finished with beads if they would like. Allow 2.5 hours.

name: Kids Twists with Beads
description: Two-strand twists with colorful beads and cuffs. Allow 1.5 hours.

name: Kids Cornrow Ponytail
description: Cornrows gathered into a neat ponytail. Holds well through school and sport. Allow 1.5 hours.

name: Takedown and Removal
description: Careful removal of any braids or twists. Includes a detangle. Free when booked with a new full style.

name: Wash and Blow-Dry
description: Cleanse, condition and stretch. Book before any long appointment for the best result. Allow 1 hour.

name: Deep Conditioning Treatment
description: Steam treatment for hair that feels dry or brittle after a long protective style. Allow 45 minutes.

name: Scalp Treatment
description: Clarifying cleanse and oil massage for a tight, flaky or sore scalp. Allow 30 minutes.

name: Braid Refresh
description: Edges and the front two rows redone to carry an existing style a few more weeks. Allow 1 hour.

name: Hair Extensions Supplied
description: We supply the braiding hair so you do not have to shop for it. Charged per style, not per pack.

name: Beads and Cuffs
description: Beads, cuffs or thread added to any braided style. Choose your colors at the chair.

name: Curl Ends and Dip
description: Braid ends sealed in hot water and set into a curl. Adds bounce to box braids and twists.
